summary: Attackers compromised a maintainer account and published malicious LiteLLM package versions that executed automatically on Python startup to harvest wallet files private keys and cloud credentials. The mechanism involved a poisoned software dependency that deployed an infostealer targeting crypto assets and infrastructure secrets.
user_mistake: Installed or updated a dependency without verifying package integrity during a compromised release window
prevention: Pin dependency versions and verify package hashes before install / Avoid installing updates during active supply chain incidents
